author: Flipped
description: A free 'Unlock gun' box in the upgrade row by your spawn. Five pixel-art guns (pistol, blaster, shotgun, ray gun, rocket launcher), each with its own flash, bullet and impact; switch with 1-5 on the hotbar. Recoil physics up to 10000%, and bullets break blocks, spikes, decorations and objects until the level reloads.
